class.name: SkyMaterial4D
class.description: A [ShaderMaterial] used by [WorldEnvironment4D] to draw a sky and provide sky ambient lighting. [SkyMaterial4D] is intended as an abstract base; use [GradientSkyMaterial4D], [PhysicalSkyMaterial4D], [PlainSkyMaterial4D], or a custom subclass. For custom materials, assign a [Shader] with [code]shader_type sky[/code]. The cross-section renderer evaluates the visible sky with [code]vec4(EYEDIR, 0.0)[/code] and supplies the following camera-relative uniforms when they are declared by the shader: - [code]vec4 world_up_direction_4d[/code] - [code]vec4 light0_direction_4d[/code] through [code]light3_direction_4d[/code] - [code]vec4 light0_color[/code] through [code]light3_color[/code] - [code]float light0_energy[/code] through [code]light3_energy[/code] - [code]float light0_angular_radius_radians[/code] through [code]light3_angular_radius_radians[/code] - [code]bool light0_enabled[/code] through [code]light3_enabled[/code] The renderer creates a private material, copies the custom material's shader parameters, and then supplies these view-dependent uniforms immediately before rendering. This allows one [WorldEnvironment4D] to render correctly from multiple 4D cameras.

members.member: The sky's overall brightness multiplier. Higher values result in a brighter background and sky ambient lighting.
